description: This file contains utility functions for normalizing and resolving attachment root paths for iMessage integrations, including path validation, normalization, and merging multiple root path lists.

methods.name: normalizePosixAbsolutePath
methods.description: Normalizes a POSIX absolute path, returning undefined if invalid.

methods.name: splitPathSegments
methods.description: Splits a path string into segments, filtering out empty segments.

methods.name: isValidInboundPathRootPattern
methods.description: Checks if a path pattern is valid for inbound attachment roots.

methods.name: normalizeInboundPathRoots
methods.description: Normalizes an array of root paths, filtering invalid or duplicate entries.

methods.name: mergeInboundPathRoots
methods.description: Merges multiple lists of root paths into a unique, normalized list.
